summary: Breeze Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO of 14,000,000 units at $10.00/unit, including partial exercise of the over-allotment, generating $140M in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 470,000 units to Breeze Sponsor II, LLC at $10.00/unit for $4.7M. $144.7M of net proceeds were placed in a trust account. The units consist of one ordinary share and one right (each right for 1/5 share). Private placement units are restricted for 30 days post-business combination and have registration rights. Watch for the SPAC's timeline to identify a target and complete a business combination within the required period, with risk-arb focus on deal terms and shareholder redemption.
